---

# 📅 POSTING TIME GUIDE

Best generic times if you don't already track your audience:

| Platform | Best time | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Facebook | Tuesday 1pm or Thursday 8am ET | B2B / operator audience checks during commute and mid-afternoon |
| Instagram feed | Wednesday 11am or Friday 11am ET | Same audience, mid-day scroll |
| Instagram Reels | Daily 6–9pm local | Evening scroll window |
| Instagram Stories | Spread 3–5 across the day | Top-of-feed, sustained presence |

Track which posts convert (use UTM parameters: append `?utm_source=fb&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch` to your Gumroad link in each post). Gumroad will show source in the Sales dashboard.

# 🔁 RECYCLING

Each post above can become 3–4 derivatives without rewriting:

- **FB → Twitter / X thread** (split the FB body into 4–5 tweets)
- **IG carousel → LinkedIn carousel** (same slides, professional polish)
- **Reel → YouTube Short** (same video, vertical 9:16, slightly different hook)
- **Quote card → Story** (Instagram Stories love quote cards)

Don't write more content. Repackage what's already here.
